ex.en: The straits were too narrow for the cruise ship.
ex.zh: 這道海峽對郵輪來說太窄了。

ex.en: We went on a cruise around Japan last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天搭郵輪環遊日本。

ex.en: The cruise includes all meals and drinks.
ex.zh: 這趟郵輪之旅包含所有餐點和飲料。

ex.en: The plane is cruising at 10,000 meters.
ex.zh: 飛機正在一萬公尺高空巡航。

ex.en: We cruised along the coast in a rental car.
ex.zh: 我們開著租來的車沿著海岸兜風。

ex.en: This job requires a lot of creativity.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要很多創意。

ex.en: We encourage creativity in our team.
ex.zh: 我們鼓勵團隊發揮創意。

ex.en: A huge crane lifted the steel beams.
ex.zh: 一台巨大的起重機吊起了鋼樑。

ex.en: Several cranes are working at the construction site.
ex.zh: 工地上有好幾台吊車在作業。

ex.en: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
ex.zh: 據說病人摺一千隻紙鶴，願望就會實現。

ex.en: Teach me how to fold a paper crane. I forgot how to fold it.
ex.zh: 教我怎麼摺紙鶴吧，我忘記怎麼摺了。

ex.en: Tom craned his neck in every direction.
ex.zh: 湯姆伸長脖子四處張望。

ex.en: He craned his neck in the hope of hearing what they were whispering.
ex.zh: 他伸長了脖子，希望能聽到他們在說什麼悄悄話。

ex.en: The company could not pay its creditors.
ex.zh: 這家公司付不出錢給債權人。

ex.en: Creditors met to discuss the debt.
ex.zh: 債權人開會討論這筆債務。

ex.en: He drew a crude map on a napkin.
ex.zh: 他在餐巾紙上畫了一張簡單的地圖。

ex.en: This is only a crude estimate.
ex.zh: 這只是粗略的估計。

ex.en: Please don't make crude jokes at work.
ex.zh: 上班時請不要開低俗的玩笑。

ex.en: His crude remarks offended many people.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的言論冒犯了很多人。

ex.en: The price of crude has fallen sharply this month.
ex.zh: 原油價格這個月大幅下跌。

ex.en: Crude oil prices rose again today.
ex.zh: 今天原油價格再度上漲。

ex.en: The company is facing a cash crunch.
ex.zh: 公司正面臨資金短缺。

ex.en: We're in a time crunch before the deadline.
ex.zh: 截止日前我們時間非常緊迫。

crunch.zh: 嘎吱作響地咬嚼；嘎吱地踩過

ex.en: She crunched on an apple during the break.
ex.zh: 她休息時喀滋喀滋地啃著蘋果。

ex.en: The snow crunched under our feet.
ex.zh: 雪在我們腳下嘎吱作響。

crunch.zh: crunch (the) numbers：大量計算、分析數據

ex.en: My job is mostly crunching numbers.
ex.zh: 我的工作大多是在算數字、分析數據。

ex.en: Let me crunch the numbers and get back to you.
ex.zh: 我先算一下數字再回覆你。

crush.zh: 迷戀、暗戀（have a crush on）

ex.en: She has a crush on the boy next door.
ex.zh: 她暗戀隔壁的男孩。

ex.en: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
ex.zh: 看來湯姆暗戀瑪麗。

ex.en: Don't crush the eggs in the bag.
ex.zh: 別把袋子裡的蛋壓破了。

ex.en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the pan.
ex.zh: 先把大蒜拍碎再放進鍋裡。

ex.en: The king crushed his enemies.
ex.zh: 國王擊潰了他的敵人。

ex.en: Our team crushed the competition this year.
ex.zh: 我們隊今年把對手打得落花流水。

credential.zh: 資格證明、學經歷（常用 credentials）

ex.en: She has excellent academic credentials.
ex.zh: 她的學歷非常亮眼。

ex.en: Applicants must show their teaching credentials.
ex.zh: 應徵者必須出示教師資格證明。

ex.en: Never share your login credentials with anyone.
ex.zh: 絕對不要把你的登入帳密告訴任何人。

ex.en: The app asks for your credentials every time you open it.
ex.zh: 每次打開這個 App，都要輸入帳號密碼。

ex.en: Karlo has the ability to understand and create.
ex.zh: 卡羅有理解和創造的能力。

ex.en: You need to create an account first.
ex.zh: 你需要先建立一個帳號。

ex.en: The company plans to create 500 new jobs.
ex.zh: 這家公司計畫創造五百個新工作機會。

ex.en: The hair style of the Beatles created a sensation.
ex.zh: 披頭四的髮型引起了轟動。

ex.en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
ex.zh: 你的行為造成了很多麻煩。

ex.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
ex.zh: 房間裡的鏡面牆營造出寬敞的錯覺。

ex.en: You cannot be too careful in crossing a street.
ex.zh: 過馬路再怎麼小心都不為過。

ex.en: Watch out for cars when you cross the street.
ex.zh: 過馬路時要注意車子。

ex.en: Betty sat in the chair with her legs crossed.
ex.zh: 貝蒂翹著腿坐在椅子上。

ex.en: A policeman was watching it, with his arms crossed.
ex.zh: 一個警察雙手抱胸看著。

ex.en: Put a cross next to the wrong answers.
ex.zh: 在錯誤的答案旁邊打個叉。

ex.en: Mark your choice with a cross.
ex.zh: 用叉號標出你的選擇。

ex.en: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.
ex.zh: 一名警探抵達犯罪現場。

ex.en: I have nothing to do with that crime.
ex.zh: 我和那起犯罪一點關係都沒有。

ex.en: They forgave him for his crimes.
ex.zh: 他們原諒了他的罪行。

ex.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
ex.zh: 偶爾不吃早餐也不是什麼罪過。

ex.en: It's a crime to waste so much food.
ex.zh: 浪費這麼多食物真是罪過。

ex.en: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
ex.zh: 我們在人群中跟丟了那個男人。

ex.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集起來看遊行。

ex.en: There was a large crowd in the park.
ex.zh: 公園裡有一大群人。

ex.en: The students are all crowding around something. What is that?
ex.zh: 學生們都擠在那裡圍著某個東西。那是什麼？

ex.en: It being Sunday, the supermarket was very crowded.
ex.zh: 因為是星期天，超市非常擁擠。

ex.en: The train was crowded, so I resorted to walking.
ex.zh: 火車太擠了，所以我改用走的。

ex.en: The moment she saw me, she burst out crying.
ex.zh: 她一看到我就哭了出來。

ex.en: When I heard the news, I wanted to cry.
ex.zh: 聽到這個消息時，我想哭。

ex.en: I never expected I would end up crying today.
ex.zh: 我沒想到今天最後會哭。

ex.en: "Help!" she cried.
ex.zh: 「救命！」她大喊。

ex.en: The children cried out with joy.
ex.zh: 孩子們高興地大叫。

ex.en: We heard a cry for help from the river.
ex.zh: 我們聽到河邊傳來呼救聲。

ex.en: The baby's cry woke everyone up.
ex.zh: 寶寶的哭聲吵醒了大家。

ex.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
ex.zh: 我不懂你為什麼對他這麼挑剔。

ex.en: The report was highly critical of the management.
ex.zh: 報告嚴厲批評了管理階層。

ex.en: This is a critical moment for the company.
ex.zh: 這是公司的關鍵時刻。

ex.en: Customer feedback is critical to our success.
ex.zh: 顧客意見對我們的成功至關重要。

ex.en: Your mother is in critical condition.
ex.zh: 你母親目前情況危急。

ex.en: The situation there was critical.
ex.zh: 那裡的情況很危急。

ex.en: His company didn't survive the crisis.
ex.zh: 他的公司沒能撐過這場危機。

ex.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
ex.zh: 那部關於環境危機的紀錄片真是讓人大開眼界。

ex.en: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
ex.zh: 遇到緊急狀況時，你一定要聯絡你的老師。

ex.en: The police were able to find the criminal.
ex.zh: 警方找到了那名罪犯。

ex.en: The criminal came out of the house with arms raised.
ex.zh: 犯人舉著雙手走出房子。

ex.en: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
ex.zh: 他兒子的犯罪行為讓他非常痛苦。

ex.en: He has no criminal record.
ex.zh: 他沒有犯罪紀錄。

ex.en: The film received good reviews from critics.
ex.zh: 這部電影獲得影評人的好評。

ex.en: She is a well-known food critic.
ex.zh: 她是知名的美食評論家。

ex.en: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
ex.zh: 這位知名登山家是大眾觀光的批評者。

ex.en: Critics say the plan is too expensive.
ex.zh: 批評者認為這個計畫太花錢了。

ex.en: Tom died two years ago in a plane crash.
ex.zh: 湯姆兩年前死於一場空難。

ex.en: She won't take an airplane for fear of a crash.
ex.zh: 她怕墜機，所以不搭飛機。

ex.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.
ex.zh: 他會撞車是因為有人動了他的煞車。

ex.en: The plane crashed shortly after takeoff.
ex.zh: 飛機起飛後不久就墜毀了。

ex.en: My laptop crashed and I lost my work.
ex.zh: 我的筆電當機，做到一半的東西都不見了。

ex.en: The website crashed because of heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 網站因為流量太大而當掉了。

ex.en: Many people lost money in the stock market crash.
ex.zh: 許多人在股市崩盤中賠了錢。

ex.en: The housing crash hurt the economy.
ex.zh: 房市崩盤重創了經濟。

ex.en: The creation of most schools was not to transform society, but to reconstruct society.
ex.zh: 大多數學校創立的目的不是改造社會，而是重建社會。

ex.en: The project will lead to the creation of 500 jobs.
ex.zh: 這項計畫將創造 500 個工作機會。

ex.en: This dish is the chef's latest creation.
ex.zh: 這道菜是主廚的最新創作。

ex.en: The website is entirely her own creation.
ex.zh: 這個網站完全是她自己做的。

ex.en: What are the criteria for choosing a supplier?
ex.zh: 選擇供應商的標準是什麼？

ex.en: Applicants must meet the following criteria.
ex.zh: 申請人必須符合以下條件。

ex.en: The selection criteria are listed on our website.
ex.zh: 甄選標準列在我們的網站上。

ex.en: People can accept praise more easily than criticism.
ex.zh: 人們比較容易接受讚美，而不是批評。

ex.en: The more public the work, the more criticism you receive.
ex.zh: 工作越公開，受到的批評就越多。

ex.en: His reply implied a criticism of our work.
ex.zh: 他的回答隱含著對我們工作的批評。

ex.en: She studies literary criticism at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學研讀文學評論。

ex.en: The book is a work of film criticism.
ex.zh: 這本書是一部電影評論著作。

ex.en: This is a crucial point.
ex.zh: 這是關鍵的一點。

ex.en: Good communication is crucial to the success of any project.
ex.zh: 良好的溝通對任何專案的成功都至關重要。

ex.en: The next few days will be crucial for the company.
ex.zh: 接下來幾天對公司來說非常關鍵。

ex.en: We grow a variety of crops.
ex.zh: 我們種植各式各樣的作物。

ex.en: The crops need rain.
ex.zh: 農作物需要雨水。

ex.en: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.
ex.zh: 透過基因改造，我們可以改良農作物。

ex.en: You can crop the photo before you upload it.
ex.zh: 你可以先裁切照片再上傳。

ex.en: I cropped the image to remove the background.
ex.zh: 我把圖片裁切掉背景。

ex.en: The chip in Yanni's windshield became a huge crack.
ex.zh: 雅尼擋風玻璃上的小缺口變成了一條大裂縫。

ex.en: There's a crack in the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上有一道裂縫。

ex.en: He cracked the walnut with his teeth.
ex.zh: 他用牙齒咬開核桃。

ex.en: The glass cracked when I poured hot water into it.
ex.zh: 我倒熱水進去時，玻璃杯裂了。

ex.en: The police finally cracked the case.
ex.zh: 警方終於破了這個案子。

ex.en: Hackers cracked the password in minutes.
ex.zh: 駭客幾分鐘內就破解了密碼。

crew.zh: （船、飛機上的）全體船員、機組人員

ex.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
ex.zh: 現代船隻只需要少數船員。

ex.en: Captains have responsibility for ship and crew.
ex.zh: 船長要對船和船員負責。

ex.en: The flight crew will serve drinks shortly.
ex.zh: 機組人員稍後將提供飲料。

ex.en: A film crew is shooting downtown today.
ex.zh: 今天有一組攝影團隊在市中心拍片。

ex.en: The repair crew arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 維修人員今天早上到了。

ex.en: Tom has a lot of creative ideas.
ex.zh: 湯姆有很多有創意的點子。

ex.en: I don't know how long I'll have to wait before I become more creative.
ex.zh: 不知道還要等多久，我才能變得更有創意。

ex.en: We need a creative solution to this problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個有創意的方法來解決這個問題。

ex.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
ex.zh: 你怎麼會想到這麼瘋狂的點子？

ex.en: It would be crazy to do that again.
ex.zh: 再做一次就太瘋狂了。

crazy.zh: be crazy about：非常熱衷、超愛

ex.en: He is not just interested, he's crazy about it.
ex.zh: 他不只是有興趣，簡直是為之瘋狂。

ex.en: My son is crazy about soccer.
ex.zh: 我兒子超愛足球。

ex.en: Grr! I'm itchy all over, and it's driving me crazy.
ex.zh: 啊！我全身都好癢，快把我逼瘋了。

ex.en: The noise from next door is driving me crazy.
ex.zh: 隔壁的噪音快把我逼瘋了。

ex.en: Tom criticized Mary in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 湯姆當著大家的面批評瑪麗。

ex.en: You're always criticizing me!
ex.zh: 你老是批評我！

ex.en: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
ex.zh: 如果我錯了，被批評我也不介意。

ex.en: Would you like some cream in your coffee?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要加一點奶精嗎？

ex.en: Would you like whipped cream on your cake?
ex.zh: 你的蛋糕要加鮮奶油嗎？

ex.en: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
ex.zh: 你不應該吃那麼多冰淇淋的。

ex.en: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
ex.zh: 我每次吃冰淇淋都很開心。

ex.en: Put some cream on your dry hands.
ex.zh: 在乾燥的手上擦一些乳液。

ex.en: This cream protects your skin from the sun.
ex.zh: 這款乳霜能保護你的皮膚不被曬傷。

ex.en: I can't imagine what creatures living on another planet are like.
ex.zh: 我無法想像住在其他星球的生物是什麼樣子。

ex.en: The octopus is an extremely intelligent sea creature.
ex.zh: 章魚是一種非常聰明的海洋生物。

ex.en: How can there exist a creature as adorable as a cat?
ex.zh: 怎麼會有像貓這麼可愛的生物？

creature.zh: creature of habit：習慣成自然的人

ex.en: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他是個很依賴習慣的人。

ex.en: My father is a creature of habit and eats the same breakfast every day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸很守習慣，每天都吃一樣的早餐。

ex.en: I greatly recommend reading it to anybody thinking of learning a craft.
ex.zh: 我強烈推薦想學一門手藝的人讀這本書。

ex.en: Children often use construction paper to make crafts.
ex.zh: 孩子們常用色紙做手工藝品。

ex.en: The market sells local arts and crafts.
ex.zh: 市集販售當地的手工藝品。

ex.en: This wood wallet is crafted from a single piece of walnut.
ex.zh: 這款木製皮夾是用一整塊胡桃木製成的。

ex.en: She carefully crafted her speech for the conference.
ex.zh: 她為研討會精心準備了演講稿。

ex.en: Students should learn to think critically.
ex.zh: 學生應該學習批判性思考。

ex.en: She looked critically at her own work.
ex.zh: 她以挑剔的眼光審視自己的作品。

ex.en: He was critically injured in the accident.
ex.zh: 他在事故中受了重傷。

ex.en: The patient is critically ill.
ex.zh: 那位病人病情危急。

ex.en: Water is critically important for crops.
ex.zh: 水對農作物至關重要。

ex.en: Timing is critically important in this project.
ex.zh: 在這個專案中，時機至關重要。

ex.en: She wrote a detailed critique of the report.
ex.zh: 她針對這份報告寫了詳細的評析。

ex.en: The professor gave a helpful critique of my essay.
ex.zh: 教授對我的論文提出了很有幫助的評論。

ex.en: Please critique my presentation before the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議前請幫我看看簡報並給些意見。

ex.en: The designers critiqued each other's work.
ex.zh: 設計師們互相評論彼此的作品。

ex.en: She wore a necklace made of crystal.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條水晶項鍊。

ex.en: The hotel lobby has a huge crystal chandelier.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳有一盞巨大的水晶吊燈。

ex.en: Salt forms small white crystals.
ex.zh: 鹽會形成白色的小結晶。

ex.en: Ice crystals formed on the window.
ex.zh: 窗戶上結了冰晶。

crystal.zh: 清澈透明的；crystal clear 非常清楚的

ex.en: The water in the lake was crystal clear.
ex.zh: 湖水清澈見底。

ex.en: Your instructions were crystal clear.
ex.zh: 你的指示非常清楚。

ex.en: Which credit cards can I use?
ex.zh: 我可以用哪些信用卡？

ex.en: We accept all major credit cards.
ex.zh: 我們接受所有主要的信用卡。

ex.en: Sorry, we don't accept credit cards.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我們不收信用卡。

ex.en: The fried chicken is crispy on the outside.
ex.zh: 炸雞外皮很酥脆。

ex.en: I like my bacon really crispy.
ex.zh: 我喜歡培根煎得很脆。

ex.en: If you want to be credible, tell people only what they believe.
ex.zh: 想讓人相信你，就只說他們本來就相信的事。

ex.en: We need credible evidence, not just rumors.
ex.zh: 我們需要可信的證據，而不是謠言。

ex.en: This will erode our credibility.
ex.zh: 這會損害我們的信譽。

ex.en: Tom lost his credibility.
ex.zh: 湯姆失去了信譽。

ex.en: I would like to pay with a credit card.
ex.zh: 我想用信用卡付款。

ex.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
ex.zh: 我通常用信用卡，不用現金。

ex.en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
ex.zh: 你帶了現金還是信用卡？

ex.en: To his credit he knows what he's talking about.
ex.zh: 值得稱讚的是，他很清楚自己在說什麼。

ex.en: She deserves credit for the team's success.
ex.zh: 團隊的成功她功不可沒。

ex.en: This course is worth three credits.
ex.zh: 這門課三學分。

ex.en: I need ten more credits to graduate.
ex.zh: 我還需要十個學分才能畢業。

ex.en: The machine parts were packed in a wooden crate.
ex.zh: 機器零件裝在一只木製板條箱裡。

ex.en: Each crate is marked with the buyer's address.
ex.zh: 每只木箱都標上了買家的地址。

ex.en: The bank checked the firm's creditworthiness.
ex.zh: 銀行查核了這家公司的信用程度。

ex.en: A record of on-time payments can improve a company’s creditworthiness.
ex.zh: 按時付款的紀錄有助於提升公司的信用可靠度。

ex.en: A good craftsman takes pride in his work.
ex.zh: 優秀的工匠以自己的手藝為傲。

ex.en: A skilled craftsman repaired the wooden doors.
ex.zh: 一位熟練的工匠修好了木門。

ex.en: I slipped and fell on the crosswalk, just when the light turned red.
ex.zh: 紅綠燈變紅的時候，我剛好在斑馬線上滑倒了。

ex.en: Always use the crosswalk when crossing the street.
ex.zh: 過馬路時一定要走斑馬線。

ex.en: It being Sunday, the supermarket was very crowded.
ex.zh: 因為是星期天，超市非常擁擠。

ex.en: On sunny days, the beach is very crowded.
ex.zh: 天氣晴朗時，海灘總是很擁擠。

ex.en: The shop was crowded with young people.
ex.zh: 店裡擠滿了年輕人。
